taxAdvantage.notes: City of Pittsburgh has repeatedly challenged UPMC's property tax exemption on downtown real estate holdings. UPMC holds multiple tax-exempt bond issues via Pennsylvania Higher Educational Facilities Authority. Precise dollar totals require Schedule H and local assessor data not verified here.

financials.source: UPMC FY2023 financial report, consolidated with UPMC Health Plan insurance revenue

executiveComp.source: ProPublica 990 Schedule J — specific Davis compensation not verified here; predecessor Jeffrey Romoff reported $11.7M in final full year as CEO
executiveComp.notes: Leslie Davis assumed CEO role in July 2021 after Jeffrey Romoff retirement. Romoff's final-year compensation was widely reported at approximately $11.7M. Davis's comp from 990 not verified in this dossier.

layoffs.notes: UPMC announced workforce reductions in early 2024 across corporate and clinical positions. Exact count not verified here.
layoffs.source: Trade press reports, requires Becker's / local news verification

keyRiskFactors: Insurance-provider integration risk via UPMC Health Plan

acquisitions.notes: Merger created UPMC Pinnacle — expanded UPMC footprint into central Pennsylvania

communityBenefit.source: UPMC community benefit reports are publicly posted; specific charity care percentages not verified in this dossier. City of Pittsburgh has repeatedly contested whether UPMC meets charitable purposes threshold for property tax exemption.

legalIssues.description: City of Pittsburgh property tax exemption challenges — city has argued UPMC operates more like a for-profit business than a charitable nonprofit
legalIssues.status: Multiple rounds of litigation and settlement attempts
legalIssues.source: Pittsburgh Post-Gazette coverage, city council records

legalIssues.description: Consent decree with Highmark over network access for Highmark insurance members at UPMC facilities — state Attorney General involvement
